design.name: 沙铁卫
design.brief: The bandit faction's hulking shield enforcer: a huge inverted-triangle body with massive shoulders and arms, a barrel chest and comparatively short legs, a small head inside a bronze suanni lion-dog face helmet with a fanged grille and two glowing ember-orange eyes. Layered iron-and-bronze lamellar armour over sand-coloured cloth, giant riveted bronze pauldrons, the faction's crimson waist sash with the gold spiral emblem, a studded dark leather tasset skirt, thick quilted trousers, heavy iron-capped boots. Huge iron gauntlets with a clearly separate thumb and four thick separate armoured fingers.
design.weapon: a tall round bronze tower shield embossed with a roaring lion face, and a short spiked iron mace
